description:
AJ Dybantsa is a 19-year-old wing for the Washington Wizards. Originally from Brockton, MA, he spent one season at BYU and earned First Team All-American honors before being selected No. 1 in the 2026 NBA Draft. 

Born to Congolese and Jamaican parents, AJ is the founder of The AJ Dybantsa Foundation, which supports youth education in Jamaica, Congo, and the US. He is finishing his mass communications degree at BYU online.

This channel covers basketball highlights, memorable off-court moments, and a window into AJ and his life as he writes the first chapter of his NBA career.
title: AJ Dybantsa
